title: A Group Chat for the Semester
author: Casper Ravensworth
blurb: Felix Crane, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the last game of the season.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
